content.text: Section 18 fully meets the preferred checklist, so no redline is warranted.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 carries a complete Vendor insurance programme at our preferred level: CGL of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate, professional E&O of USD 2,000,000, cyber and privacy liability of USD 5,000,000 (unconditional, and Vendor does host and process Customer Data per Section 17), and workers' compensation as required by law. Section 18.2 provides certificates of insurance on request, plus additional Customer-favourable terms (primary coverage, notice of cancellation, insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities). No qualifying or self-insurance language elsewhere dilutes these limits, so the clause sits at preferred and requires no redline.
